An '''[[Adarian/Legends|Adarian]] child''' lived in [[Makrin City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shelkonwa]]<ref name="Allegiance" /> in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Allegiance (novel)|''Allegiance'']] to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].</ref> One day, when housebreakers tried to break into an apartment of a theater's employee, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]&mdash;who hid from the Empire in Shelkonwa&mdash;felt obligated to save the child. She planned to do this by confronting the housebreakers with her [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. However, after the first shots the housebreakers ran away, because the whole neighborhood woke up and they feared that residents could discover them. The next day, his parents thanked Organa by not betraying her to the Empire.<ref name="Allegiance" />
